newsitem.title: DOMINICAN REPUBLIC: Dominican president "bomb" was sand - authorities.
newsitem.headline: Dominican president "bomb" was sand - authorities.

text.p: The Dominican Republic's chief of security said on Thursday an object found at a Santo Domingo historic site initially suspected of being a bomb targeting President Leonel Fernandez was found to have been a container of sand.

"There was speculation and an investigation was ordered, but it was determined that the device was not explosive," Sigfrido Pared Perez, director of the National Department of Investigations, told Reuters.

Government officials had said on Wednesday that the device, the exact nature of which they did not disclose, was hidden at an historic site at which the president was scheduled to lay a wreath last Thursday, the 153rd anniversary of the Dominican Republic's independence.
Pared Perez said the president's security had not been increased.
